segments.text: We mean to be a part of it.
We mean to lead it.
For the eyes of the world now look into space,
to the moon, and to the planets beyond.
And we have vowed that we shall not
see it governed by a hostile flag of conquest,
but by a banner of freedom and peace.
We have vowed that we shall not see space
filled with weapons of mass destruction,
but with instruments of knowledge and understanding.
Yet the vows of this nation can only be fulfilled
if we in this nation are first, and therefore
we intend to be first.
